sections.title: Everything behind the scenes, on one screen.
sections.lead: Check-in at the door, a live console for the night, a dress rehearsal before it, and a team where everyone sees what they need. The work of running an event, handled.

sections.title: Know who’s here in the first five minutes.

items.title: Most guests scan in
items.body: A code at the door opens your event in their phone’s browser. They confirm with their number and they’re in.

items.title: No phone? You tick them off
items.body: Search the list by name and check them in yourself. A group booking checks in together, on one pass.

items.title: Turned up unbooked? You let them in
items.body: Add a walk-in in a few seconds, if you have room. They’re on the list for the follow-up too.

items.title: Booked somewhere else? Bring the list
items.body: Import a guest list from a CSV or Excel file. On Luma Plus, connect Luma and refresh to bring in its latest guest list.

items.question: Do guests need to download anything?
items.answer: No. The code at the door opens your event in their phone’s browser. They confirm with their phone number.

items.question: What if someone’s phone is dead?
items.answer: Search their name and check them in yourself. A group booking checks in together, on one pass.

items.question: What happens with no signal?
items.answer: Check-ins made without signal are saved on the phone, and sync when you’re back online.

items.question: Does a rehearsal send real messages?
items.answer: No. Nothing in a rehearsal reaches a real event.

items.question: How do safety reports work?
items.answer: Guests can report a problem privately from their phone, and {{brand.name}}’s safety team follows up.

items.question: I sell tickets on Luma. Can I still use the door?
items.answer: Yes. If you’re on Luma Plus, connect your Luma account and refresh the guest list whenever you want the latest. Or import a guest list from a CSV or Excel file.
